entries.title: I Samuel 3:1
segments: ¶And the child Samuel ministered unto the LORD before Eli. And the word of the LORD was precious in those days; [there was] no open vision.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:2
segments: And it came to pass at that time, when Eli [was] laid down in his place, and his eyes began to wax dim, [that] he could not see;

words.text: And it came to pass at that time

entries.title: I Samuel 3:3
segments: And ere the lamp of God went out in the temple of the LORD, where the ark of God [was], and Samuel was laid down [to sleep];

entries.title: I Samuel 3:4
segments: That the LORD called Samuel: and he answered, Here [am] I.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:5
segments: And he ran unto Eli, and said, Here [am] I; for thou calledst me. And he said, I called not; lie down again. And he went and lay down.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:6
segments: And the LORD called yet again, Samuel. And Samuel arose and went to Eli, and said, Here [am] I; for thou didst call me. And he answered, I called not, my son; lie down again.

words.text: , Here [am] I; for thou didst call

entries.title: I Samuel 3:7
segments: Now Samuel did not yet know the LORD, neither was the word of the LORD yet revealed unto him. {Now...: or, Thus did Samuel before he knew the LORD, and before the word of the LORD was revealed unto him}

words.text: unto him. {Now...: or, Thus did Samuel before he knew the LORD, and before the word of the LORD was revealed unto him}

entries.title: I Samuel 3:8
segments: And the LORD called Samuel again the third time. And he arose and went to Eli, and said, Here [am] I; for thou didst call me. And Eli perceived that the LORD had called the child.

words.text: , Here [am] I; for thou didst call

entries.title: I Samuel 3:9
segments: Therefore Eli said unto Samuel, Go, lie down: and it shall be, if he call thee, that thou shalt say, Speak, LORD; for thy servant heareth. So Samuel went and lay down in his place.

words.text: : and it shall be, if he call

entries.title: I Samuel 3:10
segments: And the LORD came, and stood, and called as at other times, Samuel, Samuel. Then Samuel answered, Speak; for thy servant heareth.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:11
segments: ¶And the LORD said to Samuel, Behold, I will do a thing in Israel, at which both the ears of every one that heareth it shall tingle.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:12
segments: In that day I will perform against Eli all [things] which I have spoken concerning his house: when I begin, I will also make an end. {when...: Heb. beginning and ending}

words.text: , I will also make an end

entries.title: I Samuel 3:13
segments: For I have told him that I will judge his house for ever for the iniquity which he knoweth; because his sons made themselves vile, and he restrained them not. {For I...: or, And I will tell him} {vile: or, accursed} {restrained...: Heb. frowned not upon them}

words.text: them not. {For I...: or, And I will tell him} {vile: or, accursed} {restrained...: Heb. frowned not upon them}

entries.title: I Samuel 3:14
segments: And therefore I have sworn unto the house of Eli, that the iniquity of Eli's house shall not be purged with sacrifice nor offering for ever.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:15
segments: And Samuel lay until the morning, and opened the doors of the house of the LORD. And Samuel feared to shew Eli the vision.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:16
segments: Then Eli called Samuel, and said, Samuel, my son. And he answered, Here [am] I.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:17
segments: And he said, What [is] the thing that [the LORD] hath said unto thee? I pray thee hide [it] not from me: God do so to thee, and more also, if thou hide [any] thing from me of all the things that he said unto thee. {more also: so add} {thing from: or, word from}

segments: And Samuel told him every whit, and hid nothing from him. And he said, It [is] the LORD: let him do what seemeth him good. {every...: Heb. all the things, or, words}

entries.title: I Samuel 3:19
segments: ¶And Samuel grew, and the LORD was with him, and did let none of his words fall to the ground.

words.text: was with him, and did let none of his words

entries.title: I Samuel 3:20
segments: And all Israel from Dan even to Beersheba knew that Samuel [was] established [to be] a prophet of the LORD. {established: or, faithful}

entries.title: I Samuel 3:21
segments: And the LORD appeared again in Shiloh: for the LORD revealed himself to Samuel in Shiloh by the word of the LORD.
